item.title: Coretronic's OLED and auto-display gains point to steadier growth as NB weakens
item.summary: Coretronic said its OLED monitor business is gaining traction as new production lines ramp up, while car displays continue to expand. The company expects full-year OLED monitor shipments to rise 70% to 80% year-over-year, even as its weaker notebook business faces a sharp downturn.
